name: halo
description: An invisible AI overlay for macOS — captures your screen, mic, and meeting audio to power a real-time AI copilot that stays hidden from screen shares.
author: shipitdev

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Halo transcribes your microphone to help you in conversations.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Halo does not use the camera.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Halo captures system audio to transcribe meeting participants.
